falsifier: A site where `dominating_def` is the only reachable mode (destinations already agree, so no combined mode applies) AND an SDA21-relocated word sits in the proof span AND the source register is not r0/r2/r13. That is a customer the census did not find, and it would turn the refinement from zero-demand into one-demand. Equally falsifying: a demonstration that `_relocation_cannot_write`'s SDA21 clause is unsound, which would make the two provers agree in the other direction and would put the shipped combined-mode rules (including game/world/newcam::fn_8006F16C and fn_8006DF34) in question.
subject: tool:webfrank
value: WEBFRANK CARRIES TWO PROVERS FOR THE SAME OBLIGATION -- `GPR rS holds K on entry to this site` -- AND THEY DECIDE AN INTERPOSED R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 WORD DIFFERENTLY, so on a composed rule the PROOF MODE, not the composition, is what a refusal is measuring. `prove_constant_source` (reached by the pure form modes `dominating_def` / `dominating_def_across_calls`) refuses any relocated word in the span whose type is outside `_IMMEDIATE_ONLY_RELOCATIONS`, SDA21 included, with the message `+0xN: relocated word inside the proof span carries relocation type 109, which may rewrite bits outside the immediate field`. `prove_constant_dataflow` (reached by the COMBINED modes `constant_dataflow_recolor` / `constant_dataflow_inverse_recolor`) asks the finer question through `_relocation_cannot_write`, which knows SDA21 rewrites exactly one field, the base register, and can only ever write r0/r2/r13 into it -- so it steps over the same word whenever the source register is not one of those three. THIS ONLY BITES WHEN A RULE COMPOSES STAGES, and `prove_constant_source`'s own docstring says so: a pre-recolor permutation can move a relocated word INTO a span that contained none in the raw stream. MEASURED, run 47, on game/world/newcam::fn_8006F16C, one function and one window: permuting [0x230,0x238) order [1,0] moves the SDA21-relocated `lwz r28,@lbl_80344A6C` between the `li r29,0` definition and the +0x238 rewrite site, and the SAME rule then REFUSES with `dominating_def` and reaches BYTE-EQUAL with `constant_dataflow_recolor` naming our source r29. Two other shapes also reach BYTE-EQUAL and are worth knowing as escapes: run the permutation LAST as a `post_recolor_permutation`, which leaves the pure-form span empty; or leave the window alone. THE COARSE BEHAVIOUR IS DELIBERATE AND PINNED, so this is a documented split and not a bug: tools/gdl/tests/test_webfrank.py::RelocatedWordInsideProofSpanTests exists for exactly this composition case and `test_sda21_relocation_may_not_be_stepped_over` asserts the refusal. THE REFINEMENT WAS SCREENED AND DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT: routing `prove_constant_source` through `_relocation_cannot_write` would be strictly finer than blanket distrust and sound by the predicate's own argument, but the DEMAND CENSUS is ZERO -- the single site measured this run proves through the combined mode already, so the change would buy no closure and would cost a guard surface plus a rewritten test. Per AGENTS.md's capability rule (soundness is necessary and not sufficient; a capability with no customer is the wanton-use failure mode in a different costume) it is recorded here instead of shipped. A later lane that finds a site whose destination register MATCHES the target's -- the shape that forces the pure mode, since the combined modes refuse a same-destination site as `a recolor, not a form change` -- is the first real customer, and should cite this record.
